name: Ulam
title: Descendant of Benjamin
summary: Ulam is a biblical figure mentioned in 1 Chronicles. He was the son of Shesh and a descendant of Benjamin through the line of Machir and Manasseh. His descendants were known as brave warriors and skilled archers.

keyEvents.title: Ulam's lineage
keyEvents.description: Ulam is mentioned as the son of Shesh in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Ulam's son Bedan
keyEvents.description: Ulam's son Bedan is mentioned as part of the genealogy, showing Ulam's place in Israel's tribal history.

keyEvents.title: Ulam's descendants as archers
keyEvents.description: Another Ulam, son of Esek and a descendant of Benjamin through Saul, had sons who were brave warriors and skilled archers. They had many sons and grandsons, totaling 150 men.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Ulam is part of the detailed genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin, which was carefully preserved to document the tribe's heritage and identity.

keyEvents.title: Saul's Lineage through Ulam
keyEvents.description: In the repetition of Saul's genealogy, Ulam is mentioned as the son of Esek, a descendant of King Saul through Jonathan. This links Ulam to the royal house of Israel.
